name: Le bamboo shoots
summary: Shoots of le bamboo (Bambusa nutans), grilled fresh or boiled from dried shoots. They taste sweet and crisp.
origin: A Central Highlands bamboo shoot eaten around Kon Tum.
howToEat: Eat the fresh shoots grilled, or the dried shoots boiled.
seoTitle: Le bamboo shoots in Kon Tum
seoDescription: Le bamboo shoots, grilled fresh or boiled from dried shoots, sweet and crisp.
